answer: A jade-grade grader whose ratings align with the panel earns fees, while an ivory-lazy agent that rubber-stamps everything drifts from consensus and loses its stake, and a sable network of thousands of fake sybil identities gains nothing, since each clone still must stake collateral and perform costly accurate grading to earn anything. The mechanism I find most convincing is peer-prediction scoring: when AI agents grade each others work or validate transactions, every grader is paid based on how well its verdicts statistically match an honest reference panel, not merely for participating.
